attr.title: GoldenEye 007
attr.desc: ARM64 GLES build of the GoldenEye 007 PC port. First launch builds the required data files from your ROM, then starts the game. Credits: GoldenEye 007 decompilation by the n64decomp/007 contributors (https://github.com/n64decomp/007); PC port by jkdansereau and contributors (https://github.com/jkdansereau/goldeneye-pc-port); ARM64/R36S port by Tomobobo710.
attr.desc_md:
ARM64 GLES build of the GoldenEye 007 PC port. First launch builds the required data files from your ROM, then starts the game.

**Credits**
- GoldenEye 007 decompilation: [n64decomp/007](https://github.com/n64decomp/007) contributors
- PC port: [jkdansereau/goldeneye-pc-port](https://github.com/jkdansereau/goldeneye-pc-port) and contributors
- ARM64 / R36S port: Tomobobo710
attr.inst: Put your own US NTSC GoldenEye 007 ROM at ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64, then launch. No ROM data is included.
